use_case_summary: Small indie studio building a code-assistant embed inside their IDE plugin (VS Code extension).
Primary flows: contextual chat with file + repo embeddings for smart suggestions and code search reranking.
Performance targets: 200-400ms median response for short completions, tail < 1s on hosted API.
Throughput: intermittent bursts from developers during active sessions (10-40 QPS bursts), overall low daily volume.
Cost sensitivity: very high — wants to keep monthly cloud inference cost < $500 initially.
Model preference: open / community models preferred for cost; interested in Redwood recommendations for quantized variants and fallback to cheaper models during low-priority calls.
Routing needs: basic region preference (us-east) and a simple fallback policy to a lower-cost model when quota exceeded.
Security: needs audit logs, basic workspace access controls; no enterprise SSO yet but may require SAML if enterprise customers onboard.
